en: "There's grass growing thick all oveer.{n} But it's amazing it grows this well{n} in a place with no sunlight at aaall."
"Are you stupid?"
"Wh-whaaat? That's so meean. Calling me{n} stupid out of nowhere is going{n} too faar."
"Hey, don't act like this is news to you."
"It's a mere 10 years since this island{n} surfaced. Yet there were grass and trees{n} in the places we've passed too, right?"
"Oh myy, now that you mention it?"
"From what the army found out, some odd{n} force is at work on this island that{n} spurs the growth of every living thing..."
"Ehh!?"
"The cause is still unknown. One theory{n} says some force field of an ancient{n} civilization is still at work."
"Then if I stay on an island like this,{n} I'll turn into more and more{n} of an old lady!"
"You... wanna die or something...?"
"Good grief. It's this dark in here and{n} there's still grass all over the place.{n} Honestly, what a pain to walk through."
"I never gave it a thought until now,{n} but when I think about it, it's odd."
"Haah?"
"It's only 10 years since this island{n} surfaced. And yet lots of grass and trees{n} grew all over the places we've passed."
"The army looked into that, too.{n} The reason's still unknown. Only,{n} strangely enough, on this island..."
"On this island?"
"Some odd force seems to be at work{n} that quickens the growth of{n} living things."
"Oh myy? There seems to be a boy out{n} in this lonely plaace? And he{n} doesn't look like a soldier, eitheer."
"No, never let your guard down.{n} Going by age, I'm not much different{n} from that kid over there myself."
"Hello there."
"Oh, yes, yes, hellooo."
"You two are a truly lovely work of art.{n} One finished whole made of two.{n} An imbalance of clashing light and dark."
"Huuh?"
"He's spouting weird stuff{n} right off the bat."
"So, who are you?"
"So, why are you here?"
"What do you mean by that?"
"He's spouting weird stuff{n} right off the bat."
"Um, excuse me, buut..."
"Who might you beee?"
"Why are you heere?"
"What does that meaan?"
"So, who are you?"
"If humans are to call me something,{n} Ymir. Still, names to tell each{n} individual apart were a fine invention."
"So, why are you here?"
"The meaning of that question is{n} vague. I cannot answer it, and if I{n} did, it would be of little use to you."
"What's that supposed to mean?"
"Adding another meaning to a meaning{n} is a bad habit of humans.{n} I meant exactly what the words say."
"And who might you be, I wondeer?"
"If humans must call me something:{n} Ymir. Names are a useful thing{n} for telling each individual apart."
"Why are you here, I wondeer?"
"The meaning of that question is{n} vague. I cannot answer it, and if I{n} did, it would be of little use to you."
"What do you mean by thaat?"
"Adding another meaning to a meaning{n} is a bad habit of humans.{n} I meant exactly what the words say."
"Tch, what's all this babbling about?{n} Good grief. Is this brat{n} cracked in the head or what?"
"U-ummm, I haven't the faintest{n} idea what you're talking abouut?"
"Pleease look? Over there... isn't that{n} the boy we met the other daaay?"
"Tch... something's fishy here."
"Hello. We meet again."
"Yeees, so it seeems."
"Look. It's that brat again..."
"It certainly seems thaat way.{n} Is this a coincidence too, I wondeer?"
"Who knows..."
"Good day. We meet again."
"Hey, you, brat. Why have you been{n} tailing us this whole time?"
"Following you? No, you are mistaken.{n} I am the one who bears the name Ymir.{n} Your guide, so to speak."
"A guide?"
"Guide us to what?"
"What do you mean?"
"Don't screw with me!"
"A guide, you saay?"
"A guide to whaat?"
"What do you meaan?"
"How interestiing."
"And what is it you're guiding us to?"
"Not a road in the physical sense.{n} I show all living things{n} the direction toward the future."
"Heh, that makes no damn sense."
"And what's that supposed to mean?"
"Meaning is what one perceives after{n} thinking. If thought is the essence of{n} humans, you too must think for yourself."
"Heh, mind your own business."
"Heh, don't screw with me!"
"By arriving at an answer like that,{n} you make the limits of your thinking{n} all the clearer to see."
"Haah? What the hell are you on about?{n} You got a screw loose somewhere{n} in that head of yours?"
"What will you be guiding us tooo?"
"Not a road in the physical sense.{n} I show all living things{n} the direction toward the future."
"R-riight...?"
"What does that meaan?"
"Meaning is what one perceives after{n} thinking. If thought is the essence of{n} humans, you too must think for yourself."
"Yees... I'm sooorry..."
"What an interesting answeer."
"'Interesting' is a perception, too.{n} By that perception and by feeling, you{n} strive to make sense of the baffling."
"Oh myyy? That boy from before{n} is standing right over theeere?"
"A guide... that's what he said."
"Could this mean that we're the ones{n} walking to wherever that brat{n} happens to be?"
"Surely not...?"
"Hello there."
"Yeees, hellooo!"
"Hello. We really do meet often."
"But is this a coincidence, I wondeer?"
"Who knows..."
"The green of plants truly soothes the{n} heart. Since ancient times humans have{n} revered green, and ruled over it too."
"What's this about, all of a sudden?"
"Ruled over it? What do you meean?"
"Hee hee..."
"By taking up farming, humans changed{n} from hunting animals into productive{n} creatures with a settled home."
"After that, they remade plants for{n} farming, and repainted even the colors{n} of flowers purely for pleasure..."
"You people are at last starting to{n} notice the chain of life called genes."
"Ge... nes... is iit...?"
"Genes."
"A few years ago, a scholar at the Royal{n} University of Rheinmetall predicted them{n} and published a paper on life's mystery."
"Though they haven't actually been{n} found yet."
"You know so muuch, Mr. {hero:6}!?"
"This is part of Special Service work{n} too. Or isn't it just that you{n} don't know anything?"
"Gulp!"
"Yes. Genes."
"Yet since ancient times, you people{n} have been recombining them{n} by rule of thumb..."
"Or selective breeding, as it is{n} also called."
"Plants may be plants, but they are{n} life. Is tampering with it as you{n} please truly something permitted?"
"Permitted or not, plants say nothing.{n} They won't take up swords and revolt.{n} Besides, farming is wisdom for survival."
"How very arrogant.{n} Is that what humans have to say?"
"Heh, what kind of crap is that!? Why{n} should I get a lecture from you,{n} when you're a human same as me?"
"Even so, the plants are alive and well.{n} Ever since we were born on this earth,{n} we have lived together with them."
"And so the plants will forgive you?"
"Plants have no words, so I've{n} never heard them say so..."
"But it's not about forgiving or not."
"Plants borrow the help of little birds{n} and squirrels to carry their seeds too.{n} Everyone works together, after all."
"Hee hee. You too know a great deal."
"No. It's something everyone knows."
"But you see..."
"The longest-lived giant trees live for{n} thousands of years. They are creatures{n} far longer-lived than you."
"And plants draw nutrients from the{n} earth, bathe in sunlight and rain, and{n} live relying on no other creature."
"Looked at one way, are they not the{n} most advanced creatures on this earth?"
"Heh, how dumb. Scholars have been{n} bringing that one up time and again{n} since way back."
"Yours is just a rehash of it.{n} Think that makes you smart? You're{n} only playing at being a scholar."
"Hee hee. The very answer I expected."
"What!?"
"I do understand what you are saying."
"But no living thing is better or worse.{n} So whether they're the most advanced{n} doesn't matter, I think, thouugh..."
"Hee hee. The very answer I expected."
"Eh?"
"But you see, it interests me."
"Long-lived beings that make something{n} from nothing. If such plants gained a{n} mind like a human's, no, a finer one..."
"How would this earth change, I wonder."
"Gentle creatures that neither kill{n} nor eat others in order to live."
"What if plants were the masters{n} of this earth, I wonder."
"He's vanished... huh..."
"Oh? What could be the matter?"
"What is this? What's starting!?"
"The green! The green's moving!?{n} Unbelievable!? Do the plants here{n} grow this fast!?"
"Kuo... oooo... oo..."
"Hey, hey, is this for real!? The{n} plants went and took a human shape!?"
"No, it IS a person!{n} A living, moving giant of plants!"
"Still, it's way too big! I haven't{n} laid eyes on a monster like this{n} since I came to this island!"
"Could it be!?"
"Could this be another of the ancient{n} weapons called Machine Gods that{n} appeared a hundred years ago!?"
"No, Machine Gods aren't living things.{n} On the outside they look like machines!"
"Besides, 100 years ago at least, no{n} Machine God had a shape like that. I've{n} never seen one in army record photos!"
"Then what?"
"A green giant in human form..."
"Call it a Machine Man, I guess!?"
"A Machine Man..."
"A giant made of plants, seriously!?{n} Show this to the biologists and they'd{n} go weak in the knees and keel over!"
"Is this a Machine Man... too!?"
"Looks like it..."
"A green Machine Man. Right,{n} a Plant Machine Man!"
"Kuoooo... oooo..."
"Listen, everyone, be on your guard!{n} Take it lightly just because it's{n} a plant and you'll pay for it!"
"The enemy is veery big! Please take{n} great care as you fight, and{n} don't get too close to it!"
"To remake a plant to this extent...{n} Whoever made this must know living{n} things very thoroughly indeed."
"A thing like this... can no longer{n} even be called a weapon."
"If science advances, will we humans{n} too someday create devilish monsters{n} like this one?"
"I know of plants that eat insects,{n} but to think a plant that attacks{n} people exists on this earth, sir..."
"I'm a professor, you know! But my{n} field is Item Studies! I don't know{n} one whit about plants!"
"Result of scan by composite sensors:{n} abnormal high energy detected,{n} unthinkable for a plant."
"Unless we fight with perfect tactics,{n} the loss rate will exceed 100%.{n} Yes, in other words: annihilation."
"Oh my, oh my!? Annihilation, is it!?{n} That is quite a dangerous enemy,{n} yes indeed!"
"Everything rests on battle command.{n} Loss rate and victory probability{n} are, in the end, only numbers."
"Numbers!? Sad to say, Li'l Tethys can{n} only count up to 10, if you please!"
"Not even worth discussing..."
"I sense an abnormal ki from that plant.{n} A ki of plant and animal mixed in one.{n} A ki I have never sensed before."
"Can you cut it... Toryu?"
"I see. I am counting on you."
"It's all squirmy and gross!{n} Prince {hero:6}! Let's hurry up and{n} beat that thiiing!"
"The green of trees is a thing that{n} calms the heart. Yet this green, it{n} seems, brims with madness and terror."
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!"
"A plant!? It's just a bunch of leaves!?{n} I'll chop it up with my heavy MG and{n} plant it in some garden somewhere!"
"Even I... can't let myself...{n} ...get killed... by plants.{n} This one... I will win... for sure..."
"It is a plant just like a devil!{n} Let us go, Mr. {hero:6}! To seal{n} the green devil away in this land!"
"It is nothing at all like the dear{n} Cosmic Tree in our village! Let us{n} burn a tree like this up, yes indeed!"
"Tch! Its sap's a weapon too!?{n} We can't just walk up to this thing!"
"That sap seems to be a strong poisoon!?"
"Tch!?"
"We managed to destroy part of its body,{n} but who'd think it would spray sap!{n} Get close and we're in trouble too!"
"Oh my!?"
"We beat one part of its body, but if{n} we get too close, we'll get poison{n} sap all over uus!"
"It went and spawned its own clone!?"
"You've got to be kidding! The main{n} body alone is this much trouble, and{n} now we have to fight its clones too!?"
"Oh my!? A child Plant Machine Maaan!?"
"Everyone, please don't let your guard{n} doown! It looks small, but I have{n} a bad feeling about this somehoow!"
"Waah! That's so not faaair!{n} We can't have babies{n} that easily ourseeelves!"
"Keh! Like a murder doll could ever{n} have a kid in the first place!"
"If you've got time to whine,{n} hurry up and join the attack!"
"Sniff... That's not true.{n} Even I... someday..."
"Left alone, it will bear children{n} without end. We have no choice{n} but to settle this swiftly."
"Making life... on a battlefield... huh..."
"What an irony... this is...{n} ...A battlefield... the place closest{n} to death... and it makes children there..."
"It is no irony, Jaguar."
"What... are you saying...?"
"In every age, life and death are two{n} sides of one coin. Will you not think{n} of living at times, not only of dying?"
"Yes, also to repay our debt to{n} {name:6}, who saved our lives."
"I suppose... so..."
"Heh! Rot away and vanish!{n} A mere plant, daring to{n} defy its human betters!"
"I'm sorry! But there was{n} no other way than this!"
"What the hell was that thing!?"
"Could it have been... a person!?"
"Don't be stupid. No way a monster{n} like that could be human!"
"No... of course not..."
"It looks like we managed to beat it."
"Honestly, what kind of island is this?"
"But do plants really have{n} a will of their own, I wonder?"
"Who knows. But since we can't talk to{n} them, either way we've got no means{n} of finding that out."
"You're right..."
"All right, let's go."
"Ah!"
"What is it, all of a sudden?"
"Please watch your step so that you{n} don't tread on the grass at your feet."
"Heh, how ridiculous!"
"Looks like those arm-like parts and{n} the main body each have a separate{n} will of their own."
"A will? In a plant?"
"What else can you call it!?"
"Anyway, all we can do is attack the{n} left and right arms and the body each.{n} Focus on one point, or spread out?"
"It doesn't look like it will let us go.{n} Anyway, let's aim for the left{n} and right arms first!"
"All right, let's get going!"
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
